description: Re-enable a previously disabled organization member so they can log in and use the platform again. Requires the org_user_id. The organization is fixed by your context — never pass an organization id. You cannot target a user more privileged than yourself, and not your own account. It is refused when the organization's plan has no free seat: its active members already fill the plan's limit (error_code SUBSCRIPTION.SEAT_LIMIT_REACHED, with the limit in error_details); tell the user that no seat is free. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

org_user_id.description: Id of the OrganizationUser to enable.

name: enable_user
title: Enable user
